title: Carson Schwesinger isn't expecting Browns defense to change much after Jim Schwartz's departure

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Carson Schwesinger isn't expecting Browns defense to change much after Jim Schwartz's departure
sources.description: The Browns have a new head coach and defensive coordinator for the 2026 season, but linebacker Carson Schwesinger isn't expecting things to look much different on his side of the ball.
